selected_locator.precision: Google Maps selected place point for STT Tokyo 1, used as a labelled property locator for the STT Tokyo Inzai Campus within Goodman Business Park. It does not establish a surveyed building or campus boundary, entrance, individual data hall or exact Tokyo 2 location.
selected_locator.identity_review: The original Google Maps response independently names the selected place STT GDC STT Tokyo 1 and attaches its exact selected-object coordinates to feature 0x60227d00058ce471:0x6a7f5e3a91b8fee5, entity /g/11n567bc0p. The operator release and currently linked Tokyo 1 factsheet establish the same facility name, Inzai location, Goodman Business Park host and first building of the two-building STT campus. The factsheet lists 2-2-5 Kaguro-Minami; the independent CASBEE Stage 7 certificate includes that exact address. Root separately observed the matching operator website, Kaguro-Minami address and plus code in the browser; those fields are not represented as present in the hashed HTTP body. No excluded directory coordinate or unnamed building containment supplies selected identity or geometry.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: Google Maps supplies no measured horizontal accuracy for the selected place. Decimal places are retained from its selected-object record and do not imply survey precision or known offsets to operating data halls.

source_geometry.browser_corroboration_scope: Root independently selected the facility through Google Maps search, observed its address, operator website and plus code, and supplied the selected-place URL. Those three fields are not asserted to occur in the hashed HTML.

derivation_review.operation: Direct copy from original Google Maps selected-object tuple [null,null,35.8173944,140.134879], reversing latitude/longitude order to GeoJSON longitude/latitude. No centroid, georeferencing, CRS transform or viewport-coordinate inference.
derivation_review.distance_formula: 2R atan2(sqrt(h), sqrt(1-h)), h = sin²(delta_lat/2) + cos(lat1)cos(lat2)sin²(delta_lon/2); angles in radians
